status: BUILT, NOT WIRED — research asset only. The served conformal path (conformal_review_service) scores lesion candidates by RAW pooled probability (score_pooling=mean, null_kind=raw_pooled_probability), NOT this learned scorer. calm_ms_scorer.LesionScorer is imported by no runtime service. Therefore the numbers below describe a configuration that is NOT the shipped guarantee; they must not be cited as the endpoint's realized coverage.
training_contamination_warning: This scorer was fit on sites [openms, mslesseg]. open_ms_data is FLAMeS-in-sample (ref-13) — the exact cohort the v2 null was DEcontaminated to exclude. So within_domain numbers are optimistically contaminated. Any future wiring of this scorer requires (a) retraining on FLAMeS-independent data only and (b) a NEW null asset built with the SAME learned statistic (null_kind=learned_score).
supersedes: prior record described a gradient-boosting model + a rigged FP-only shift

cross_site_generalization.note: honest cross-domain estimate; per-site AUCs (~0.77) hide this

honest_conclusion: The learned score is a genuine WITHIN-DOMAIN TP/FP improvement (AUC 0.80 vs 0.70 raw, well-calibrated) but does NOT solve cross-site non-exchangeability (LOSO AUC ~0.62) and under a FAIR monotone shift does NOT beat raw probability. It is not, by itself, the F1 fix.
